envelope.description: Follow the anchor in the planning recipes and the synthesizer prompt

body.title: Follow the anchor in the planning recipes and the synthesizer prompt
body.summary: Change the recipes in src/prompts/analyze/decompose.system.md from hits[0].path to anchor.path and the instruction in src/prompts/analyze/synthesize.code.system.md to centre on the anchor; for a symbol anchor chain symbol-aware explorations on the entity id and skip or label file-level dependents (module.profile, convention.detect) as contextual file expansion.
acceptanceChecks: a module-scope request profiles the named module through the real dependent runners even when the question shares no word with it
a small symbol in a large file keeps file-level explorations skipped or labelled contextual and is sized and searched as the one entity
legacy repo and workspace plans behave as before

tests.name: request-end-to-end.test.ts: a module-scope request profiles the named module with no lexical match and a small symbol in a large file runs symbol-aware runners, skips or labels file-level runners and synthesis centres on the symbol
